title: Explanation And Instructions On Why There Are Two Updates Every Day Recently
content:
Explanation And Instructions On Why There Are Two Updates Every Day Recently

! ! ! ! ! !

Send six exclamation points first, indicating that the author does not want to do this exclamation.

Regarding the reason, the author has already said the author's words in the previous chapter, but the author is afraid that some people are not used to reading the author's words, so I will post a new one to explain it again.

That's right, the author has really found a job, and he doesn't have much time to write novels every day. This is because of work, forced by life, and helpless.

Before I graduated and practiced for a year, the author was very ashamed to be an old man for more than half a year. During this period, I went out to find a job, but after working for three days, I felt too hard and couldn't stand it, so I went home to rest.

After more than half a year, after the Chinese New Year, I kept looking for a job. A few days ago, I just found a job that I could continue to do and that was more satisfactory.

The author can only try it.

Because of this work, the author can spare every day, and there is not much time to write a book.

The reason why I wrote the book was that the author stayed at home every day for more than half a year. Apart from helping the family look at the store, he was alone, very boring, and wanted to find something else to do.

After much deliberation, it seems that there is nothing else the author can do.

Amidst the irritability, the author couldn't help but think of the novels he had read for more than six years. The author wanted to write novels a long time ago.

After reading so many novels, I believe that many people have the idea of writing novels, but they have not put them into action.

The first time the author actually wrote a novel was a few years ago, when the author was bored during the summer vacation and stayed alone in the room with a pen to write.

But the author, a person who has never passed the composition, wrote more than 8,000 words, and felt that the author's life was over, so he could only reluctantly give up and seal the novel he wrote in the book used to pretend to be an old book. inside the box.

The second time, the author wrote a novel of more than 10,000 characters in Tangyuan Creation, and then wrote, I felt that the author's accumulation was not enough, the writing was too bad, and the imagination was not too rich, so he was a natural eunuch.

Now the author is writing it for the third time, and he didn't expect to be able to sign a contract and then put it on the shelves.

At the beginning, I heard from others that there were not many people out of 100 who could sign the contract. There are only one or two out of a thousand people who can be put on the shelves. When the author received the news of signing the contract and putting it on the shelves, there were some small surprises and complacency for no reason. (I wonder if everyone can understand the joy of being recognized by others for their hard work!)

Along the way, the author's writing journey is extremely boring and boring.

At the beginning, the author wrote more than 20,000 words in two or three days because of his great interest, and then began to publish. As a result, when the author sent him 20,000 words, he received a signed short notice.

Before the author wrote it, I checked it on the Internet and heard that someone said that it takes 100,000 words to sign a contract, and the author can sign a contract with 20,000 words. Does it mean that my work is excellent?

It was only later that I found out that the author was just a slut, and I felt ashamed when I thought back to my original thoughts.

After signing the contract, the author continued to work hard to update, maintaining a minimum of two updates a day, and later changed it to three updates, and broke out from time to time. (The main reason is that I look at the store alone, and it is too boring, so I can only use my time to write novels.)

During the period, the author went to check his background every day, and added a few recommendation tickets, a few more comments, a few more clicks, and a few more favorites.

I'm not afraid to tell everyone that during that time, the author had to go through his backstage more than a dozen times a day, and sometimes twenty or thirty times.

But people's passion will always pass. After writing him for more than 20 days, almost a month later, the author's grades are still at the same level, and it can even be said to be very poor.

And most of the comments were criticizing and scolding the author. When the author saw it, he was not angry as others said, but just felt a little sad.

For these comments, as long as they are reasonable, these authors accept them humbly.

If you are a person who has been following the author, you should know that for those who scolded the author in the book review area, except for the first few days, the author was afraid that those book reviews would affect the appearance of the whole book, so he deleted two or three articles to clean up the book. .

Later, the author thought about it again, and these people said that there was nothing wrong with them. After all, they spent time reading it, which meant that they had devoted a certain amount of time to this book. Nothing is impossible.

The author does not want to cover up this point, because the author sometimes reads other books and will say it when he is poisoned. Now that he is an author, he does not want to treat them differently and deny those who read my book.

Therefore, the author has never deleted the book review since then, and now there are still a lot of bad things about the author in the book review area, but the author has nothing bad to do, at most, he just pretends that he has not seen it.

The author only has a technical secondary school education, saying that the culture is at most a junior high school culture, and he is a relatively poor student in a junior high school, otherwise he would not have gone to a technical secondary school.

I was able to write this book entirely out of interest. After I wrote a little bit of results, I signed a contract and put it on the shelves. Only then did I come up with the idea of using it to earn some pocket money.

However, the author can clearly tell everyone that it has been more than three months since this book was written, and the author has not received a penny of remuneration for the manuscript. (The cheating author's share will exceed 200 before the author's remuneration system will be released!)

Can write for so long? Apart from the author's interests and hobbies, it is difficult to find other reasons for writing so many words. Why was the author able to write so many words?

I believe everyone knows that for the same book, with the author's grades, basically all authors will choose eunuchs.

Having said so much, the author suddenly realized that he was off topic, so he turned back. Due to work reasons, the author's update has slowed down, but here I promise that there will be no eunuchs. Even if there are two updates every day, the author will continue to write.

Now the only motivation that supports the author to continue writing, apart from the support of the readers, is the author's desire to finish the first book with a million words and not be eunuchs.

The author is also deeply affected by other novel authors, because of poor grades and being poisoned by eunuchs, how can I become one of them!

After all, almost all of them have the number of characters in a novel, so the author stopped talking nonsense and went to write first.
